name: High School Dog Simulator
source: The story is centered around Shiba, a dog who has just been released on parole from prison. As part of a new government program, he's offered the chance to commute his sentence if he can prove that he's capable of being a regular member of society again. To do so, he must attend high school in Tokyo and stay out of trouble at all costs.
translation: 故事围绕一只名叫Shiba的狗展开，它刚刚获准假释出狱。根据政府推行的新计划，只要它能证明自己有能力重新融入社会，成为普通的一员，就有机会减刑。为此，它必须到东京的一所高中就读，并且无论如何都不能惹上麻烦。
